function read(...values: number[]) {
  const args: typeof arguments = arguments;
  const inner = () => {
    const length: typeof arguments.length = args.length;
    return length;
  };
  return inner();
}
console.log(read(1, 2));

const pair: [number, string] & { tag?: string } = [1, 'a'];
const handlers: [(x: number) => number] & { tag?: string } = [x => x + 1];
const actions: ((x: string) => number)[] & { label?: string } = [x => x.length];
console.log(pair[1], handlers[0](3), actions[0]('hello'));

const positive = +1;
const asserted = +2 as const;
const one: 1 = positive;
const two: 2 = asserted;
function move(direction: -1 | 1) { return direction; }
console.log(one, two, move(+1), move(-1));
